sql: SELECT COUNT(*),SUM(goal IS NOT NULL),SUM(goal IS NOT NULL AND (sl IS NULL OR goal<sl)),SUM(goal IS NOT NULL AND sl IS NOT NULL AND goal>sl),SUM(tp_pct<3.2) FROM outcomes WHERE version='f82bcff' AND shadow=0 AND closed=1 AND ts<=? AND coverage>=.98 AND (goal IS NULL OR goal BETWEEN 0 AND 86400000) AND (sl IS NULL OR sl BETWEEN 0 AND 86400000) AND (tp IS NULL OR tp BETWEEN 0 AND 86400000) AND (ms_mfe IS NULL OR ms_mfe BETWEEN 0 AND 86400000) AND (ms_mae IS NULL OR ms_mae BETWEEN 0 AND 86400000)
